question: Which of the following is a polar molecule?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Water.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Water has a polar molecule.**
 
• Unequal sharing of electrons makes water a polar molecule.
 
• So even though the electrons from each atom are attracted by both oxygen and hydrogen, the electrons are a bit more attracted to the oxygen.
 
• This means that electrons spend a bit more time at the oxygen end of the molecule.
